The paper contradicts itself on screening (text: Jan 2023-Dec 2024, 195 patients; Figure 1: Jan-Apr 2023, 151 patients), norepinephrine counts (20 vs 9+12) and Figure 2C vs text P values; the primary endpoint exists only in figures. Author contact is warranted
No count of placement attempts is reported; GLM's quote does not state 20 and the value is an unflagged inference

Neither code fits: the paper reports an occlusion test ('occlusion technique was used to confirm the appropriate balloon location') in heavily sedated/paralysed patients. Precedent (wang_2018, dong_2023, both a location-confirming occlusion test) codes dynamic_occlusion_test; 'other' and 'signal_quality_verification_only' both miss an occlusion test that the enum names
PEEP set to expiratory Ptp 0-5 cmH2O plus inspiratory Ptp < 25 cmH2O limit; same structure as Talmor 2008, zhao_2025, dong_2023, which were settled as combined_end_expiratory_and_end_inspiratory
The paper never states how Ptp was computed and does not cite Talmor for the method (C14 does not apply); not_reported is literal
The only timing information is relative to intubation (eligible after < 72 h of IMV); same coding as dong_2023

Balloon-guided management began at randomisation, somewhere within 0-72 h of IMV; no distribution is reported, so the population cannot be placed relative to the 48 h cut; 'mixed' asserts a spread the paper does not show
